description: Run quality gate checks on the project. MUST be called before declaring any coding task complete. Checks code complexity, file size, required docs, security patterns, and more. Returns PASS or FAIL with details. **Always show the user the headline summary from this tool's output** — it tells them what Rigour caught. If FAIL, call rigour_get_fix_packet for structured fix instructions with exact file locations and step-by-step remediation.

apiBaseUrl.description: Custom API base URL for self-hosted/proxy deep endpoints.

apiKey.description: Optional cloud API key for deep analysis.

cwd.description: Absolute path to the project root.

deep.description: Deep mode: 'off' (default), 'quick' (deep enabled with lite model), 'full' (deep enabled, combine with pro=true for full deep model).

files.description: Optional file paths (relative to cwd) to limit scan scope for both deterministic and deep checks.

modelName.description: Override cloud model name for deep analysis.

pro.description: Use full deep model (Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B) instead of lite (Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B) when deep is enabled.

provider.description: Cloud provider for deep analysis (claude, openai, gemini, groq, mistral, together, deepseek, ollama, etc.).

name: rigour_check
